episodes.synopsis: Kohaku is forced to destroy Ryusui's statue to prove that she isn't a spy.
episodes.title: The Kingdom of Science's Counterattack

episodes.synopsis: The team revives Kaseki to work on the drone. Meanwhile, Ginro is called to see the Master.
episodes.title: The Medusa's True Face

episodes.synopsis: More of the Kingdom of Science is brought back from petrification, but they are discovered in the cave by Moz.
episodes.title: Deal Game, Test of Wit

episodes.synopsis: Moz and the Kingdom of Science form a tenuous, temporary alliance against Ibara. How long it will last is a question they can't afford to concern themselves with just yet.
episodes.title: Battle in Three Dimensions

episodes.synopsis: The Kingdom of Science attacks and tries to execute their plan to steal the petrification device. Moz convinces Kirisame to use the device, but Ryusui's instincts tell him something is off about the situation.
episodes.title: Total War

episodes.synopsis: The Kingdom of Science members launch an attack on the islanders aboard the Perseus, but Moz isn't far behind and Senku and the others are forced to retreat inside the vessel. Ibara has them cornered, but Senku unleashes his Joker card.
episodes.title: JOKER

episodes.synopsis: Yo and the Kingdom of Science capture the petrification device, but Ibara isn't going down without a fight.
episodes.title: Flicker of Doom

episodes.synopsis: Much to Ibara's shock and dismay, Senku devised a plan and managed to escape petrification. Now the two enter into a head-to-head battle for control of the Medusa device.
episodes.title: LAST MAN STANDING

episodes.synopsis: Senku stands victorious. He then works on reviving the others and fixing their communications device, but while they are talking with Ruri they encounter a strong interference with the signal.
episodes.title: FIRST DREAM

episodes.synopsis: To the moon! That's the plan, at least. Senku and the Kingdom of Science need to devise a means with which to go to the moon and deal with Why-Man. The first step is allying with the people of Treasure Island and enlisting their help with some new crafts.
episodes.title: Treasure Island

episodes.synopsis: With the petrification device in the Kingdom's hands, it's time to revive Tsukasa. But there's just one problem: the device is out of batteries.
episodes.title: BEYOND THE NEW WORLD
